_doc: Joint-group definitions for PD parameterization (Stage A of sim2sim_mass-matrix-adaptive). Each family declares one or more groups; a group is identified by an IR-role regex matched against ir_canonical.json's family roles. (omega_n, zeta) defaults live in pd_groups_defaults.json. Robots inherit family defaults; per-canvas overrides are stored on the ActuatorPDNode (not in this registry). NEVER hand-edit kp/kd numbers here -- only the regex + rationale. Engine-specific kp/kd are derived at runtime by application.physics.{mujoco_gain_solver, physx_gain_solver}.

quadruped._doc: Each leg has 3 actuated DOFs in series: hip_AA (abduction, lateral) -> thigh_FE (fore/aft) -> calf (knee). foot/sensor/misc are body roles, not joints, and are intentionally NOT covered here.

hip_x.label: Hip AA (abduction)
hip_x.rationale: Low-excursion abduction DOF; overshoot is visually offensive on hardware. Default omega_n is low and zeta is critically damped.

hip_y.label: Hip FE (flexion-extension)
hip_y.rationale: Primary swing driver; must track gait harmonics ~20+ rad/s (trot/pace ~2-3 Hz). Under-damping is mildly OK for energy efficiency.

knee.label: Knee
knee.rationale: Carries the largest M off-diagonal coupling with hip_y in MuJoCo. Mismatch here is the canary indicator for sim2sim engine drift.

biped._doc: Bilateral lower-body + optional upper-body. Aggregate single-DOF roles (hip_L, ankle_L, shoulder_L, wrist_L) AND axis-split roles (hip_pitch_L, ankle_pitch_L, ...) are both folded into the matching axis group via regex. Aggregates are treated as the primary axis: hip_L -> hip_y; ankle_L -> ankle_pitch; shoulder_L -> shoulder_pitch; wrist_L -> wrist_pitch.

hip_x.label: Hip Roll (abduction)
hip_x.rationale: Frontal-plane abduction; low-excursion, prioritize no overshoot.

hip_y.label: Hip Pitch (flexion-extension)
hip_y.rationale: Sagittal-plane primary swing driver; tracks walk/run gait harmonics. Aggregate hip_L/R folded here.

hip_z.label: Hip Yaw
hip_z.rationale: Transverse-plane yaw; low-excursion, similar profile to hip_x.

knee.label: Knee
knee.rationale: Largest mass-coupling joint; canary indicator for sim2sim drift.

ankle_pitch.label: Ankle Pitch
ankle_pitch.rationale: Sagittal ankle; takeoff/landing energy. Aggregate ankle_L/R folded here.

shoulder_pitch.label: Shoulder Pitch
shoulder_pitch.rationale: Sagittal-plane shoulder swing for arm-swing locomotion. Aggregate shoulder_L/R folded here.

wrist_pitch.label: Wrist Pitch
wrist_pitch.rationale: Sagittal wrist; aggregate wrist_L/R folded here.

waist.label: Waist
waist.rationale: Torso pivot; high mass-coupling with both legs and arms. Aggregate + all 3 axis-split roles folded together.

neck.label: Neck / Head
neck.rationale: Head orientation joints; low mass, high bandwidth tolerated.

finger.label: Finger / Thumb (per-knuckle)
finger.rationale: Finger knuckle joints; much lower inertia than limb joints, separate omega_n tier.

humanoid._doc: Alias of biped; same group definitions.

manipulator._doc: Single-arm chain: shoulder -> elbow -> wrist -> hand. Aggregate single-DOF roles only.

shoulder.label: Shoulder
shoulder.rationale: Proximal arm joint; largest inertia downstream.

wheeled._doc: Wheeled chassis: per-wheel drive. wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR are kinematic contact links in ir_canonical; some platforms expose them as actuated revolute joints.

wheel.label: Wheel (drive)
wheel.rationale: Continuous-rotation drive joint; velocity control is more common than position PD, but a high-bandwidth PD around target velocity works for tracking tasks.

generic._doc: No joint groups defined. A generic robot has no actuated DOFs in the canonical; if a robot using the generic family declares joints, the compile-time resolver will fail with a clear 'no group covers this role' error and the user must override the family or extend pd_groups_custom.json.
